name: schmidbauer-mktplc
description: Claude Code plugins and skills by Matze Schmidbauer

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Two-stage cross-model code review through the OpenAI Codex CLI: one Codex model finds issues with verbatim quotes, a second model verifies each one against the repository.

plugins.name: design-audit
plugins.description: Two skills that share one rule file: design-audit checks a live website's visual design and perception on desktop and mobile with browser measurements and a simulated glance test, and design-build applies the same rules while you build or redesign UI.

plugins.name: no-ai-slop
plugins.description: Writing rules against AI-sounding prose and fabricated claims, with pattern catalogues for English and German.

plugins.name: wakemux
plugins.description: Run side tasks as Claude Code threads in cmux worktrees; each thread reports back to the main session and wakes it.
